name: Focus Room
postCreateCommand: npm install && ([ -f .env ] || cp .env.example .env) && (bash setup-browser-service.sh || echo 'Browser sidecar setup skipped — deep search will fall back to standard search.')

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: OpenRouter API key (https://openrouter.ai/keys). Powers all agents, including the researcher's web search and the deep-search browser sidecar.
